definitions.explanation: A fast-flowing river or section of river with strong currents. Japan's mountainous terrain produces many such rivers.

examples.japanese: {急流|きゅうりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}される→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: To be swept away by the rapids.

examples.japanese: {急流|きゅうりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦カヌー→カヌー：25682_kanuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had the experience of going down the rapids in a canoe.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上流|じょうりゅう}→上流：15028_jouryuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ほど{急流|きゅうりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: This river becomes more rapid the further upstream you go, so swimming is dangerous.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan has many {急流|きゅうりゅう} due to its steep mountain terrain and short rivers. Well-known examples include the three great rapids of Japan: {最上川|もがみがわ}, {富士川|ふじかわ}, and {球磨川|くまがわ}. Rafting and canoeing on {急流|きゅうりゅう} is a popular outdoor activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急流|きゅうりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧ (to go down the rapids)
- {急流|きゅうりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}される→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ (to be swept away by rapids)
- {急流|きゅうりゅう}⟦{下|くだ}り→下り：02659_kudari⟧ (river rafting, going down rapids)
- {急流|きゅうりゅう}{釣|づ}り (fishing in rapids)
